archetypes.name: dyn-quiet-authoring
archetypes.rationale: The prompt contract must suppress narration without hiding required control-flow output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 5b.5 quiet-authoring wording across SKILL.md and finalize-step5.md. Verify required breadcrumbs, generation-failure warnings, and the Step 5c anti-halt blockquote remain visible while free-form narration is excluded. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
